newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU beef management committee approves beef advance.
newsitem.headline: EU beef management committee approves beef advance.

text.p: The European Union's beef management committee on Friday approved increased advance payments to beef farmers.
The proposal to pay 1996 support advances from October 1 rather than November 1 means that some 500 million Ecus will be taken from this year's farm budget rather than in 1997.

"The measure will mean a saving in the next financial year which will make it easier to meet the costs of additonal support and aid to the beef sector because of the mad cow crisis," a Commission official said.
The management committee approved an increase in the suckler cow premium to 115.92 Ecus per head from 86.94 ecus.
It also approved and increase in the male bovine premium to 86.96 Ecu per head from 65.92 Ecus.
The proposal which must be approved by the European Commission increase the advances from 60 to 80 per cent. The balance must be paid by June 1 1997.
